model_scope.workload_assumptions: Single CPU; static CPU-bound tasks (always runnable, non-preemptive quanta); task count bounded by max_tasks per class.
model_scope.verifier_type: Custom SMT scheduler analyzer implemented via Z3 over linear integer arithmetic.
model_scope.kernel_distinction: This formal analyzer verifies scheduling-level properties (starvation, CPU share bounds) under our formal model. It is NOT the Linux in-kernel BPF verifier (which checks register safety/memory safety). Real-kernel sched_ext loading and execution have not been attempted and remain Phase 4 objectives.
